findings.title: Close the role transition for private predecessor checks, native definitions and registration

findings.title: Explicitly version the malformed composed snapshot newline escape
findings.decodedLine: WHEN 2 THEN needle:='BEGIN';replacement:='BEGIN'||E'\n'||' IF zasp_approval_maintenance.catalog_ready() IS NOT TRUE OR pin IS DISTINCT FROM ''-- approval maintenance checksum'' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE=''42501'',MESSAGE=''approval snapshot profile rejected'';END IF;';
findings.evidence: The decoded Go SQL string contains two literal backslash bytes inside PostgreSQL escape string E followed by quote, backslash, backslash, n, quote. PostgreSQL evaluates that escape string to literal backslash+n, not a newline. The generated replacement inserts BEGIN followed by those literal characters before IF, which is not valid PL/pgSQL body syntax. This source defect survives a role-only installer repair.
findings.fix: Do not silently modify embedded immutable SQL/checksum or canonical predecessor fingerprints. If fixing, issue a separately explicit reviewed approval source/checksum successor with only the intended newline serialization correction and rebind downstream exact profile pins. Role-only repair cannot claim installation readiness while this independent source issue remains.
